summary: Director, Investment Structure Management candidate with 8 years of combined professional and graduate experience across quantitative finance, cross-functional project delivery, and analytical oversight of institutional investments. Delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics; led complex multi-workstream deliveries end-to-end — an enterprise cash-flow projection engine, a legacy-platform migration for all assigned client accounts, and a three-plan pension merger study — with AI-enabled tools and Python automation in daily production use. CFA charterholder; dual MSc.

sections.heading: Cross-Functional Delivery & Project Management
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine end-to-end — scoped requirements, sequenced workstreams across modelling and product teams, and delivered base, stress, and reverse-stress capability across portfolio horizons.
Prepared analytical summaries and investment-committee-ready reporting for Heads of Risk and senior stakeholders, translating complex quantitative outputs into decision-useful commentary.

sections.heading: Analytical Oversight & Governance
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement, cumulatively covering ~$50bn of client assets — identify issues, determine course of action, and drive resolution prior to release.
Member of the model governance committee — methodology review and challenge, documentation and benchmarking standards, and assessment of performance for client-delivered analytics.

sections.heading: AI-Enabled Tools & Automation
bullets: Own implementation of AI-enabled development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE LLM agents) — automated code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation; reduced delivery cycle time ~30–40% on comparable modules.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls — in production across the team, driving continuous improvement in operational efficiency.
Led onboarding and implementation of the PFaroe DB and PFaroe PM platforms for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms.

Drove the migration of all assigned client accounts from a legacy Calypso environment — coordinated timelines and dependencies across client investment teams and product/development functions, resolved operational and configuration complexities, and validated implementations post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — coordinated actuarial, finance, IT, and risk functions on milestone delivery across complex insurer balance sheets.
Advised cross-functional stakeholders on governance documentation, controls, and regulatory readiness supporting implementation.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for the University Pension Plan (UPP) three-plan merger — end-to-end project management on a team of three, developing and validating the model evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies across the merging entities.
Presented quantitative findings to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients — Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation analysis under stress and sensitivity testing.

Performed asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR/CVaR and built stochastic scenario generators (Monte Carlo) assessing interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for institutional portfolios.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
